newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Profit-taking weighs Hungary's MOL down.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking weighs Hungary's MOL down.

text.p: The shares in Hungarian oil and gas company MOL Rt opened sharply lower on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Wednesday as profit-taking reached them after heavy gains in the past few days, traders said.
"MOL...took the BUX index on its shoulders in the past two days, so one could expect the trend to reverse sooner or later," one trader said. "We can call this profit-taking."
MOL opened at 3,350 forints, below Tuesday's close of 3,425 forints and slid to a daily low of 3,240 forints. Later MOL recovered slightly and at 1113 GMT it stood at 3,350 forints, down 75.

This week MOL bucked the market's declining trend and its strong gains -- from Friday's close of 3,080 forints to a new record high of 3,480 on Tuesday -- pushed the BUX index to new highs, while rest of the key stocks drifted mostly lower.
